title: Agent Skills
description: A skill is a named instruction you invoke with / and a Bot follows. Yours are yours alone, and go on the Bots you own.
loadError: Your skills could not be loaded.
empty: You don't have any skills yet.

workspace.title: Workspace skills
workspace.description: Written for everyone by an administrator. Which Bots carry them is decided in Admin.

editing.loadError: This skill could not be loaded.
editing.missing: That skill no longer exists, or it is not yours to edit.
editing.title: Edit skill
editing.changesApply: Changes apply the next time /{{slug}} is used. Agents already carrying it keep it.

new.description: A named instruction you invoke with /. It goes on the Bots you own, and nobody else sees it.

fields.commandLocked: A command cannot be changed. To rename a skill, write a new one and delete this.
fields.commandHint: What you type after a slash. /{command}
fields.title: Title
fields.oneLinerPlaceholder: Turns yesterday's work into a standup update
fields.oneLinerHint: Shown beside the command in this list and in the / menu. Optional.
fields.instructionsPlaceholder: Summarise what I did yesterday from the channel, then list what is left.
fields.instructionsHint: Added to the run when the command is used. Write it as instructions to the Bot, not as a description of them.

agents.title: Agents
agents.noneOwned: You do not own an Agent to put this on yet.
agents.offersHint: An Agent carrying this offers /{{slug}} in its composer.

tools.label: Tools it needs
tools.loadError: Could not load the tools this deployment has.
tools.noneOffered: No connected server offers a tool yet. A skill can still be written — most are instructions rather than tool use.
tools.elsewhereHint: This skill names these, and no server connected here offers them — because the connector has not been added, or was removed. They cost nothing and load nothing until it exists. Click one to stop naming it.
tools.grantsNothing: Picking this skill is what loads these tools for a turn. It does not grant them — a Bot still only calls what it was granted, so naming a tool here gives nobody access to it.
tools.researchTitle: {{ref}} — on whichever research connector the Bot holds

proposed.nothingSavedYet: Nothing is saved until you press the button.
proposed.title: Title
proposed.grantsNothing: Naming a tool grants nothing. A Bot is offered these only if an administrator has already granted them to it.
proposed.unwritable: The Bot's draft was not a valid skill, so nothing was saved. It has been told what to fix.
